doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: The role of radio in early exposure to the music
summary: Radio was the first exposure for many musicians and was better than television.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: And it’s really interesting how big a part that the radio played back at that time.
Everyone has mentioned that they listened to it. Their first exposure to a lot of this music was the radio.
Radio was much better then than television is today you know. Really. I won’t go into it.
Yeah, I know. We could do a whole hour on that probably. So when you got to New York, how long did you stay with that group?
